title: EU SEMICeu Core Vocabularies
usedFor: EU public-sector canonical models — conformity (CCCEV), legal entities, addresses, identifier schemes (CPOV, Core Location, ADMS). The natural anchor for operator identity and conformity assertions.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey. The SEMIC publication has not been read.
finding: The one foundational vocabulary here published by the same institution that writes the law we implement, which makes it the strongest anchor available for operator- and conformity-shaped terms. Note the namespace is `http://`, not `https://` — EU persistent identifiers are commonly minted on `http` and must be reproduced exactly rather than silently upgraded, since an IRI is compared as a string.
nextStep: Read the Core Vocabularies specifications for the conformity and legal-entity terms, and check whether IR (EU) 2026/1778 Art. 12's semantic repository builds on them — Art. 11(2) says data models 'may build on existing Union semantic assets, controlled vocabularies and reference data models', which is most likely a reference to these.
